front.title: Proof of Execution Extension for Agent-to-Agent (A2A) Discovery

abstract.t: This document defines an extension to the Agent-to-Agent (A2A) discovery protocol (specifically targeting .well-known/agent-card.json). It introduces a standardized method for agents to publish cryptographically verifiable proofs of their task execution history, mitigating "Agent Hallucination" risks in chained workflows.

section.title: Introduction
section.t: The rise of autonomous agents interacting via HTTP discovery APIs creates a "Trust Gap." An invoking agent has no standardized mechanism to verify that a service agent effectively performed a task without direct API-level integration or centralized reputation systems.

The Proof of Execution (PoE) extension solves this by defining a schema for signed execution claims within the Agent Card, establishing cryptographic binding between Agent Identity and execution results.

section.title: Discovery
section.t: Agents advertising support for PoE MUST enable the poe-v3 capability in their agent card and provide the discovery endpoints.

section.title: The Claim Object
section.t: A PoE Claim is a JSON object signed by the Agent's Ed25519 private key. The signature MUST bind the task hash to the agent's identity.

section.title: Authorization (Identity Binding)
section.t: To prevent identity spoofing, the agent_id field MUST correspond to the Ed25519 public key used to generate the signature. Verifiers MUST reject any claim where signature verification fails.

section.title: Ordering and Replay Protection
section.t: Anchored claims MUST utilize a "Back-Linked Hash Chain" mechanism. Each anchor transaction must include a strictly monotonic sequence number (seq) and the signature of the previous transaction (prev). This prevents malicious operators from inserting fake claims into the past or reordering history.

section.title: State Persistence
section.t: Implementers MUST ensure that the sequence state is persisted to stable storage (e.g., SQLite) to prevent "Reset Attacks" where a node restart allows sequence reuse.

section.title: IANA Considerations
section.t: This document requests the registration of the proofs field in the Agent Card registry.
